rationale: app-debloat has no settings registry or credentials. Real runs produce per-app evidence ledgers, inventory snapshots, triage output, plans and verification records, which the operator stores in the PRIVATE app-debloat-config companion declared by storage.contract.json. Built per-app scripts keep their own journal and logs under %ProgramData%\AppDebloat\<app>\ on the target machine, outside any repository.
